title: AEIP Scholars Programme 2026/2027
caption:
🎓 AEIP Scholars Programme 2026/2027

A fully sponsored Africa-Europe research collaboration pairing ten young scholars to co-develop solutions and present at international dialogues.

📅 Deadline: 31 August 2026
✅ Eligibility: Researchers aged 25-35 enrolled in PhD, postdoc, or advanced study, based in Africa or Europe and affiliated with a recognised institution

No fees. No gatekeeping. Full details + how to apply (link in bio):
